verdict.rationale: Bland documents voice cloning itself (a ~10-second clean sample sets the quality ceiling) which supports the 'clone a custom brand voice' half of the story, but no evidence describes a documented consent process, verification, or authorization requirement for cloning someone's voice. missing for 10: documented consent/verification workflow for voice cloning, legal/compliance guidance on brand-voice rights, independent confirmation of the cloning feature's fidelity.
